QuestInfo.name: Maple Idol Week 4
QuestInfo.0: Maple Idol auditions have begun! Could you be Maple World's next quiz idol?
QuestInfo.1:
#rMaple Idol#k auditions have begun! Could you be Maple World's next quiz idol?

You can join Maple Idol between 2:30 PM and midnight every Saturday from 12/18/2010 to 01/08/2011.

See the judge NPCs in a town near you.
Judges can be found in Henesys, Kerning City, El Nath, Ludibrium, Leafre, and Magatia.
QuestInfo.2: You decided to participate in Maple Idol.

0.0: Did you hear about <Maple Idol>, the new MapleStory quiz show? \r\nI have a feeling you'd do really well in it.
0.1: This is a once in a lifetime opportunity! Would you like to register for the preliminaries?

yes.0:
It's simple. You'll get a hint, and you just have to fill in the blanks.

If you do well, you can win all sorts of cool stuff, like a Race Car mount or even some Cash items.
yes.1:
One more thing!

If you win 4 weeks in a row, you'll be entered to win some awesome real life prizes.

Go find a judge in town to enter.

no.0: I'm sorry to hear that. Oh well...

1.0: How did you do? You did great, right?

default.0: Find one of the judges in a nearby town and challenge yourself to become the next Maple Idol.
